task.title: Add secondary action support to VSCode TreeView
task.description: The VSCode extension TreeView currently only displays one action per task. Tasks with multiple valid actions (qa: Approve/Rework, pr: Merge/Rework, in-progress: Continue/Save WIP) only show the primary action. Add support for displaying all available actions with visual distinction between primary and secondary actions.
task.problem: The TreeView uses getNextAction() which returns a single TaskAction, but task-actions.computer.ts returns multiple actions for certain statuses. Users cannot trigger secondary actions (like Rework) from the TreeView - they must open task.xml or use the terminal manually.
task.value: Users can trigger secondary actions directly from the TreeView without opening files or using terminal. Improves workflow efficiency and makes alternate actions more discoverable. Particularly valuable for the common QA rework flow.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a task in qa, pr, or in-progress status And the task has multiple valid actions defined When the user expands the task in TreeView Then all available actions are displayed as ActionItems
Given a primary action (first in the list) When it is rendered in the TreeView Then it uses a green play icon (existing behavior)
Given a secondary action (not first in the list) When it is rendered in the TreeView Then it uses an orange reply icon to visually distinguish it
Given a task in qa status When expanded in TreeView Then both "Approve" (primary) and "Rework" (secondary) actions are visible
Given a task in pr status When expanded in TreeView Then both "Merge" (primary) and "Rework" (secondary) actions are visible
